writeup: TIC 348787043 is a candidate eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 3.7497 days. Analysis of TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse causing the star to dim by 1.74%, with a detection significance of 38.7 on the BLS signal-to-noise scale. Pixel-level image analysis provides additional support, showing a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 7.5, though the centroid offset of 5.8 arcsec from the target merits further investigation. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel find. The automated pipeline assigned it a machine-learning screening score of 0.49, and it passed all data quality checks without flags.
